How many forms in the collection come from federal, New York State and New York City agencies?
SELECT gov, count(*) AS forms FROM govblock_reference.forms GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which kinds of molecules does ChEMBL hold?
SELECT molecule_type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_molecule_dictionary WHERE molecule_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many papers have been withdrawn from PubMed's records?
SELECT count(*) AS deletions FROM govblock_health.pubmed_deletions
Which states have the most onshore wind capacity?

SELECT state, round(sum(mw)) AS wind_mw FROM (SELECT state, plant_code, generator_id, max(try_cast(nameplate_capacity_mw AS double)) AS mw FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable WHERE technology = 'Onshore Wind Turbine' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much in deposits did FDIC-insured banks hold at the end of 2024?
SELECT sum(try_cast(dep AS double)) AS deposits_thousands FROM govblock_finance.fdic_financials WHERE cast(repdte AS varchar) = '20241231'
Which parts of the Defense Department paid for research behind the most patent applications?
SELECT level_two AS component, count(DISTINCT pgpub_id) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_gov_interest_org WHERE level_one = 'Department of Defense' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many substations operate at 500 kilovolts or more?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_electric_substations WHERE try_cast(max_volt AS double) >= 500
Which states fill the most antibiotic prescriptions under Medicare Part D?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Geography And Drug

SELECT prscrbr_geo_desc AS state, sum(try_cast(tot_clms AS double)) AS antibiotic_claims FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_geography_and_drug WHERE prscrbr_geo_lvl = 'State' AND antbtc_drug_flag = 'Y' AND source_file = (SELECT max(source_file) FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_geography_and_drug) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of PubChem bioassays are confirmatory tests?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN aid2activityoutcomemethod = 'Confirmatory' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_bioassay_aid2activityoutcomemethod
Which kinds of magnetic ordering are most common among computed materials?
SELECT ordering, count(*) AS materials FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Who is listed as the chief officer of Cornell University?
SELECT instnm, chfnm, chftitle FROM govblock_education.ipeds_hd WHERE instnm LIKE 'Cornell University%' LIMIT 5
Which customer sectors have the most utility rate schedules?
SELECT sector, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.utility_rate_database WHERE sector IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many coal-fired units reported to EPA's Clean Air Markets programs in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.campd_facility_attributes WHERE year = 2023 AND primary_fuel_type LIKE 'Coal%'
Which agencies pass the most federal awards on to the organisations they fund?
SELECT passthrough_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_executive.fac_passthrough WHERE passthrough_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Where did New York's electricity come from in 2023, fuel by fuel?

SELECT fuel_category, round(100.0 * sum(try_cast(gen_mw AS double)) / sum(sum(try_cast(gen_mw AS double))) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_fuel_mix_rtfuelmix WHERE substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which states have the largest share of veterans among adults?

SELECT g.name, round(100 * (max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B21001_E002' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END)) / max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B21001_E001' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END), 1) AS pct_veterans FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b21001' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many drug mechanisms in ChEMBL involve inhibiting the target?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_drug_mechanism WHERE action_type = 'INHIBITOR'
Which sources have deposited the most substances in PubChem?
SELECT c1, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_substance_sid_map WHERE c1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was New York City's highest hourly electricity load in 2022?
SELECT max(try_cast(integrated_load AS double)) AS highest FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_zonal_load_hourly_palintegrated WHERE name LIKE 'N.Y.C%' AND substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2022'
How are GDB-11's molecules spread across sizes, by number of heavy atoms?
SELECT heavy_atoms, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.gdb_gdb11 WHERE heavy_atoms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the median age of people living in Maine?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0400000US23' AND variable = 'B01002_E001'
Which counties contain the most water area?
SELECT name, usps AS state, max(try_cast(awater_sqmi AS double)) AS water_sq_mi FROM govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_counties GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many economically significant rules did OIRA finish reviewing in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS reviews FROM govblock_executive.oira_eo_reviews_completed WHERE economically_significant = 'Yes' AND cast(date_completed AS varchar) LIKE '2023%'
Which funders have the most grant awards listed?
SELECT display_name, try_cast(awards_count AS double) AS awards FROM govblock_scholarly.openalex_funders ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many companies on EDGAR have had their registration revoked?
SELECT count(*) AS revoked FROM govblock_sec.submissions_companies WHERE flags LIKE '%REVOKED%'
Which computed materials are the stiffest by bulk modulus?
SELECT formula_pretty, try_cast(regexp_extract(bulk_modulus, 'vrh=([0-9.]+)', 1) AS double) AS bulk_modulus_gpa FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many NSF awards to New York institutions took effect in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS awards FROM govblock_grants.nsf_awards WHERE statecode = 'NY' AND substr(awardeffectivedate, 7, 4) = '2023'
Which specialties have the most clinicians opting out of Medicare?
SELECT specialty, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_opt_out_affidavits WHERE specialty IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many materials does the Materials Project rate as thermodynamically stable?
SELECT count(*) AS stable FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary WHERE cast(is_stable AS varchar) = 'true'
Which public schools have the largest teaching staffs?
SELECT sch_name, st, try_cast(teachers AS double) AS teachers FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_059 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator = 'Education Unit Total' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many adverse drug event reports received in 2019 involved a death?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.fda_drug_event WHERE seriousnessdeath = '1' AND substr(receivedate, 1, 4) = '2019'
Which companies spent the most on research and development in calendar 2023?

SELECT entity_name, max(try_cast(val AS double)) AS research_and_development FROM govblock_sec.companyfacts WHERE concept IN ('ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense') AND frame = 'CY2023' AND unit = 'USD' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did U.S. coal consumption change from 2005 to 2023?
SELECT period, try_cast(value AS double) AS billion_btu FROM govblock_energy.eia_seds_data WHERE series_id = 'SEDS.CLTCB.US.A' AND period IN ('2005', '2023') ORDER BY 1
Which states enrolled the most newly eligible adults under the Medicaid expansion in December 2019?

SELECT state, max(try_cast(total_viii_group_newly_eligible_enrollees AS double)) AS newly_eligible FROM govblock_health.medicaid_medicaid_enrollment_new_adult_group WHERE cast(enrollment_year AS varchar) = '2019' AND cast(enrollment_month AS varchar) = '12' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people were hired across the U.S. economy in December 2024?
SELECT value AS hires_thousands FROM govblock_labor.bls_jt_data WHERE series_id = 'JTS000000000000000HIL' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M12'
Which larger auto insurers had the worst complaint ratios in New York in 2024?
New York Auto Insurer Complaint Rankings

SELECT company_name, try_cast(ratio AS double) AS complaint_ratio FROM govblock_insurance_filings.ny_auto_insurer_complaint_rankings WHERE filing_year = '2024' AND try_cast(premiums_written_in_millions AS double) >= 10 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How did the price power plants paid for natural gas change from January to December 2020?
Eia923 Eia Schedules M Final Revision Page Fuel Receipts And Costs

SELECT month, avg(try_cast(fuel_cost AS double)) AS avg_cost FROM govblock_energy.eia923_eia_schedules_m_final_revision_sheet_page_fuel_receipts_and_costs WHERE fuel_group = 'Natural Gas' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' AND try_cast(month AS integer) IN (1, 12) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY try_cast(month AS integer) LIMIT 10
Which states have the most citizens of voting age?
SELECT geoname, try_cast(cvap_est AS double) AS citizens_18_plus FROM govblock_elections.cvap_state WHERE lntitle = 'Total' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did U.S. crude oil exports change from January 2015 to January 2024?
SELECT period, try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_barrels_per_day FROM govblock_energy.eia_pet_data WHERE series_id = 'PET.MCREXUS2.M' AND period IN ('201501', '202401') ORDER BY 1
Which reactors were shut down for the longest stretch in 2022?
SELECT trim(unit) AS unit, count(*) AS days_at_zero FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_power_status WHERE reportdt LIKE '%/2022 %' AND try_cast(power AS double) = 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many business establishments were there in Harris County, Texas, at the end of 2023?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry
SELECT try_cast(qtrly_estabs AS double) AS establishments FROM govblock_labor.qcew_quarterly WHERE area_fips = '48201' AND own_code = '0' AND industry_code = '10' AND year = '2023' AND qtr = '4'
Which states had the highest unemployment rate in the 2024 survey?

SELECT g.name, round(100 * (max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B23025_E005' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END)) / max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B23025_E003' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END), 1) AS pct_unemployed FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b23025' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many chemistry preprints were posted to ChemRxiv each year?
SELECT substr(posted_date, 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS preprints FROM govblock_scholarly.chemrxiv_items GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
